scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=fear-social --commit-dirty=true
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply fear-social-db --remote --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply fear-social-db --local --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.mobile:build: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:add: npm run build && npx cap add ios && node scripts/prepare-ios.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/prepare-ios.mjs
